name: instant-stack-vendored-assets
description: Pinned versions of the browser JS vendored into static/assets/js (used by the Graph Explorer). After Renovate bumps a version here, run `npm install && npm run vendor` to refresh the vendored files and their MIT license notices (LICENSE-<package>.txt).

scripts.vendor: cp node_modules/cytoscape/dist/cytoscape.min.js node_modules/cytoscape-fcose/cytoscape-fcose.js node_modules/cose-base/cose-base.js node_modules/layout-base/layout-base.js static/assets/js/ && for p in cytoscape cytoscape-fcose cose-base layout-base; do cp node_modules/$p/LICENSE static/assets/js/LICENSE-$p.txt; done
